title: iNeuron Pre-Differentiation and Differentiation Protocol
author: Merissa Chen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcrjiv4n
materials: WTc11 iPSC Culture and Maintenance by Martin Kampmann
Aspirate media from iPSCs and wash with DPBS.
Aspirate media and wash with DPBS.

steps.title: Coat plates with Matrigel
steps.instruction: Dilute Matrigel in Knockout DMEM, add to culture plates, and incubate at 37 °C for at least 30 minutes (or overnight); coated plates remain usable for up to 14 days in the 37 °C incubator.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Matrigel dilution in Knockout DMEM.
Add the diluted Matrigel to the desired plates.
Incubate at 37 °C for ≥30 min (or overnight).
Store coated plates at 37 °C; they are stable for up to 14 days.

steps.title: Detach and collect cells for pre‑diff
steps.instruction: Add Accutase, incubate at 37 °C for 3 min (extend up to 7 min if needed), gently agitate to release cells, collect in DPBS‑containing tube, spin at 200 × g for 5 min, and resuspend pellet in N2 pre‑differentiation medium.

substeps.instruction: Add Accutase to the culture.
Incubate at 37 °C for 00:03:00; if cells are not detached, extend incubation up to 00:07:00.
Gently agitate to release cells.
Collect the cell suspension in an Eppendorf tube or conical tube containing DPBS.
Spin at 200 × g for 00:05:00.
Resuspend the cell pellet in N2 pre‑differentiation medium.

steps.title: Count and seed pre‑diff cells
steps.instruction: Count cells, add the desired number to a tube, spin, resuspend in N2 pre‑differentiation medium, and plate onto the Matrigel‑coated vessels at the density indicated in the seeding‑density chart.

substeps.instruction: Count the harvested cells.
Aliquot the desired number of cells into a tube.
Spin briefly to pellet the cells.
Resuspend the pellet in N2 pre‑differentiation medium.
Plate the cells onto Matrigel‑coated culture vessels using the recommended seeding density.

steps.title: Pre‑diff media changes
steps.instruction: Perform a half‑volume media change daily (with doxycycline, without ROCK inhibitor) during days 0‑3, or a full media change on day ‑1 or day ‑2; keep the schedule consistent throughout the pre‑differentiation period.

substeps.instruction: Each day from day 0 to day 3, replace 50 % of the pre‑differentiation medium while maintaining doxycycline and omitting ROCK inhibitor.
Alternatively, perform a complete medium replacement on day ‑1 or day ‑2.
Maintain the chosen schedule consistently.

steps.title: Freeze pre‑diff cells
steps.instruction: Freeze pre‑differentiated cells in a solution of 10 % DMSO in N2/B27 differentiation medium (or alternatively in pre‑differentiation medium).

substeps.instruction: Prepare freezing solution: 10 % DMSO mixed with N2/B27 differentiation medium (or with pre‑differentiation medium).
Resuspend cells in the freezing solution.
Aliquot into cryovials and place in a controlled‑rate freezer or Mr. Frosty before storage in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Prepare single‑cell suspension for differentiation
steps.instruction: Ensure cells are in a single‑cell suspension before differentiation; optionally pass the suspension through a cell strainer.

substeps.instruction: Inspect the cell suspension for clumps.
If clumps are present, pass the suspension through an appropriate cell strainer.

steps.title: Detach and collect cells for differentiation
steps.instruction: Add Accutase, incubate at 37 °C for 3 min (extend up to 7 min if needed), gently agitate to release cells, collect in DPBS‑containing tube, spin at 200 × g for 5 min, aspirate DPBS/Accutase, and resuspend in Classic N2/B27 differentiation medium.

substeps.instruction: Add Accutase to the culture.
Incubate at 37 °C for 00:03:00; extend up to 00:07:00 if cells remain attached.
Gently agitate to detach cells.
Collect the cell suspension in an Eppendorf or conical tube containing DPBS.
Spin at 200 × g for 00:05:00.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant (DPBS/Accutase).
Resuspend the cell pellet in Classic N2/B27 differentiation medium.

steps.title: Count, dilute, and plate differentiation cells
steps.instruction: Count the cells, dilute to the appropriate density, and plate onto PDL‑coated culture vessels.

substeps.instruction: Count the harvested cells.
Dilute the cell suspension to the density recommended for differentiation.
Plate the cells onto PDL‑coated vessels.

steps.title: Freeze leftover cells after preparation
steps.instruction: Freeze any leftover cells in pre‑differentiation medium supplemented with 10 % DMSO.

substeps.instruction: Prepare freezing solution: pre‑differentiation medium + 10 % DMSO.
Resuspend leftover cells in the freezing solution.
Aliquot and store as described for cryopreservation.

steps.title: Day‑3 full media change
steps.instruction: On day 3 post‑plating, perform a full media change once debris is observed.

substeps.instruction: Inspect the culture for debris.
Replace the entire medium with fresh Classic N2/B27 differentiation medium.

steps.title: Weekly differentiation media change
steps.instruction: Change Classic N2/B27 differentiation medium at least once per week without doxycycline or ROCK inhibitor; pipet at the wall of the plate and avoid touching the bottom, especially in 96‑well plates.

substeps.instruction: Schedule a full medium replacement at a minimum of once every 7 days.
During the change, add and remove medium by pipetting against the wall of the well/plate.
Do not let the pipette tip touch the bottom of the well or plate (critical for 96‑well formats).
Do not include doxycycline or ROCK inhibitor in the replacement medium.

steps.title: Monitor and use differentiated cultures
steps.instruction: Closely monitor the cultures; wait a minimum of one week before experimental use, preferably two weeks.

substeps.instruction: Observe cultures regularly for health and morphology.
Do not use the cultures for experiments before at least 7 days have elapsed.
For optimal results, plan to use cultures after 14 days.
